title: Gold Saver Account: Integration with Business Checking
summary: This document explains how the Gold Saver Account integrates with business checking to automatically sweep eligible surplus funds into savings. It specifies a $10.00 monthly maintenance fee, a $100 minimum sweep trigger, and a $0.00 automatic sweep transfer fee, including sweep/no-sweep rules based on available funds.
faqs: What does integrating Gold Saver with my business checking do?
Is there a monthly maintenance fee for the integration, and how much is it?
What is the minimum amount in checking required to trigger an automatic sweep transfer?
Do I pay a fee for each automatic sweep transfer?
